t_advice_summary_textbox.text: pink and purple seem to give the most points. however the participant also mentioned that once you start earning a lot they start to give less, so it might be wise to also go for the blue gnome every now and then.

vb_textbox.text: from my experience red and pink provided the most mushrooms especially when it was at 5x. however towards the end you will notice a difference at the performance of the pink gnome and thus, brown will start providing me mushroom. red definitely consistently provided the most mushrooms. also, blue and purple would also give a great amount. ultimately try and look for a pattern if you can but these colours definitely gave the most mushrooms of them all.
